rule_text: Set the max size before entry and start with about a third
coded_form: max notional M = L x sleeve; first tranche M/3

rule_text: Add only when the trade is 2-5% in profit
coded_form: adds of M/3 at hourly closes >= 1.02 / 1.05 x entry1
comparisons: R0 vs S4; R0 vs S5

rule_text: Never average down or top up a loser
coded_form: re-entry needs a fresh signal; an add is cancelled below the average entry
L = 3 isolated, capped so S sits 2 points above liquidation

rule_text: Stick to a few liquid coins
comparisons: R0 vs S12_top3; R0 vs S12_top6; R0 vs S12_top10

coded_form: R0: a midline exit within 72 h of entry1 is not acted on while the mark is at or above the average entry; H8(a): a 72-h minimum hold
note: R0 suppressed 0 midline exits under the literal rule 6 (Full window); H8's component (a), the 72-h minimum hold, changes 2 of 92 signals

rule_text: Wait for the breakout to confirm; cut on the trend breaking
coded_form: entry on a daily close above the upper band

rule_text: Exit in one go or two pieces at most
coded_form: 50% at the 3R take-profit, the rest on the midline
comparisons: R0 vs S10_tp_all; R0 vs S10_no_tp

rule_text: When wrong, cut all of it
coded_form: the stop and the midline exit close every tranche
verdict_source: built in: every exit closes all tranches (no variant)

rule_text: Every position gets a wide stop and a take-profit of at least 3x the risk
coded_form: S = SMA20 - 1 x ATR14; TP = entry1 + 3 x (entry1 - S)
comparisons: R0 vs S9_lower_band; R0 vs S9_sma_2p5atr; R0 vs S10_tp_all; R0 vs S10_no_tp

rule_text: Don't size up after a big month
coded_form: sizing equity frozen for the month after a month above +25%

rule_text: Don't open trades on a Friday or Saturday
coded_form: no first-tranche fill on a New York-date Fri / Sat (deferred, re-checked)

rule_text: Never open in the 90 min before the US open; enter 3.5 h before or 30 min after it
coded_form: entries at the 06:00 or 10:00 New York window

rule_text: Close 3.5-5.5 h after the US open
coded_form: trend exits at the 13:00 New York window

rule_text: Don't cut on Monday because of the weekend
coded_form: midline exits of the Sat / Sun closes deferred to Monday's close
note: H8 is NO EDGE through its component (a) (72-h minimum hold) only; rule 15's own component (b) has a 99.625% bound of +0.36% of M, above E = 0.25%, so on its own the data cannot tell
